verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that answers are grounded in real-time web search with inline citations, both in the consumer app ("Cited sources for every answer") and through the Agent API. A community user says Perplexity has replaced Google for them. Hands-on reports, however, say cited links are sometimes mismatched to the answer text and that sources can include SEO-spam listicles; this is a quality caveat, not a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that citations reliably match the claims they support, and evidence of source-quality filtering against spam.
